1.0.0.en: Rewritten in Python using the official hoymiles-wifi library. Improved support for DTU-WLite, DTU-Pro, and DTU-Pro-S. Auto-detection of panel count, three-phase, hybrid, and encrypted inverters. No cloud required.

1.1.1.en: Rewritten in Python using the official hoymiles-wifi library. Full support for DTU-WLite, DTU-Pro, and DTU-Pro-S (encrypted). Auto-detection of panel count, three-phase, hybrid, and encrypted inverters. Automatic night-time detection — device stays available overnight. No cloud required.

1.1.2.en: Rewritten in Python using the official hoymiles-wifi library. Full support for DTU-WLite, DTU-Pro, and DTU-Pro-S (encrypted). Auto-detection of panel count, three-phase, hybrid, and encrypted inverters. Automatic night-time detection — device stays available overnight. No cloud required.

1.1.3.en: Added support for 10 languages: Dutch, German, French, Italian, Swedish, Norwegian, Spanish, Danish, and Polish.

1.1.6.en: Fix pairing crash: replace self.homey.__() with self.homey.translate()

1.1.7.en: Fixed: pairing crash — "Homey object has no attribute '__'" error when DTU cannot be reached

1.1.9.en: Added confirmation step during pairing to review and correct auto-detected DTU structure before creating capabilities. Added repair flow to update DTU IP and encryption settings without re-pairing. Multiple DTUs can now be added in a single pairing session. Fixed: night-time detection now correctly disabled when Homey geolocation is unavailable. Fixed: panel data mapped by enumeration index instead of port number, preventing missing panel readings.

1.1.10.en: Improved pairing flow: automatic network scan first, with manual IP fallback only when discovery fails. Multiple DTUs can be found and added in a single flow. Removed the repair flow. Optimized sun time calculation by caching sunrise and sunset once per day.

1.1.11.en: Improved pairing flow: automatic network scan first, with manual IP fallback only when discovery fails. Multiple DTUs can be found and added in a single flow. Removed the repair flow. Optimized sun time calculation by caching sunrise and sunset once per day.

1.1.12.en: Fixed: pairing no longer asks for panel count when auto-detection is confident (live inverter data). Fixed: total power (W) and daily energy (kWh) on the main device card now show correct values on DTUs that report zero at the DTU level (e.g. DTU-WLite-S with HMS-1600-4T) — per-panel values are summed automatically as a fallback.

1.1.13.en: Added: Flow card triggers and conditions for automations (solar production started/stopped, daily summary, data updated, is solar producing). Fixed: Solar production started trigger no longer fires on every app restart. Fixed: night backoff activating at wrong hours when Homey location is not configured.

1.1.14.en: Fixed: app crash on startup when Homey location is configured — error saving coordinates to device settings was not handled correctly.

1.1.15.en: "Multilingual capability titles that follow the Homey app language. Re-pairing required to apply the new titles."

1.1.16.en: "Multilingual capability titles that follow the Homey app language. Re-pairing required to apply the new titles."

1.1.17.en: Improved DTU recovery after overnight offline periods.

1.1.18.en: Preserves the last valid daily energy value when a DTU reports zero at the end of the day, and improves diagnostics for DTU-Pro-S no-data recovery.

1.1.19.en: Improved recovery for encrypted DTU-Pro-S / DTU WLite-S devices after overnight offline periods.

1.1.20.en: Fixed night-time detection for locations west of UTC (e.g. UTC-6) where sunset falls on the next calendar day in UTC. The app now polls correctly during local daytime and only backs off during local night.

1.1.21.en: Fixed a crash during encrypted DTU recovery when Homey fails to save refreshed DTU settings such as signal strength, firmware info, or encryption metadata. Polling now continues after unexpected polling errors instead of stopping silently.

1.1.22.en: Fixed a possible startup failure when encryption settings became corrupted. Improved crash resilience so a single bad panel reading no longer skips the rest of a poll update. Reduced routine log verbosity so diagnostic reports capture more useful history leading up to an issue instead of repeated status lines. Added a Fault/Alarm Detail capability that decodes the inverter's warning code into readable text instead of just an on/off alarm flag. Added two device settings, "Show per-panel voltage/current detail" and "Show AC connection voltage/current detail", to hide the per-panel and AC-connection Voltage/Current tiles if you only need the power readings — on by default, no re-pairing needed to change. Restored the repair flow (removed in v1.1.10) — fix the DTU IP address or refresh encryption settings without removing and re-adding the device.
